checks.waitFor: .skill-directory-card span[title="该技能会使用的系统权限"]

checks.script: async () => { const region = document.querySelector('section[aria-label="所需权限"]'); const items = region ? region.querySelectorAll('li').length : 0; return { status: items === 4 ? 200 : 400, text: 'items=' + items }; }

async () => { document.querySelector('button[aria-label="查看技能：杂志风格长文排版"]')?.click(); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800)); const region = document.querySelector('section[aria-label="所需权限"]'); const items = region ? Array.from(region.querySelectorAll('li')).map(item => item.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()) : []; const ok = items.length === 2 && items[0].includes('读取本机上传文件') && items[1].includes('在本机写出成果文件'); return { status: ok ? 200 : 400, text: items.join(' | ') }; }
